zhx_build_gui_roster = {
    zhx_clear_gui_roster = yes
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            exists = yes
            has_country_flag = zhx_member
        }
        zhx_allocate_gui_roster_slot = yes
    }
    set_global_flag = zhx_gui_roster_initialised
    gdd_build_eoc_member_roster = yes
    gdd_build_eoc_great_feudatory_roster = yes
}

# MNG is deliberately excluded without changing the Zhou Council roster.

gdd_build_eoc_member_roster = {
    gdd_clear_eoc_member_roster = yes
    CZH = {
        # Membership changes compact the entire roster from slot 01 onward.
        # Return to page one so a country pulled forward from slot 49 is
        # immediately visible in the final slot of the first page.
        clr_country_flag = gdd_eoc_member_roster_page_2
        set_variable = {
            which = gdd_eoc_member_count_cache
            value = 0
        }
    }
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            exists = yes
            has_country_flag = zhx_member
            NOT = { tag = MNG }
        }
        gdd_allocate_eoc_member_roster_slot = yes
        CZH = {
            change_variable = {
                which = gdd_eoc_member_count_cache
                value = 1
            }
        }
    }
    set_global_flag = gdd_eoc_member_roster_initialised
}

# Six compact targets for the non-principal great-feudatory shields and the
# removal test. Unlike the general member roster, these targets only contain
# current holders of the dynamic zhx_major_feudatory dignity.
gdd_clear_eoc_great_feudatory_roster = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_01 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_01
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_02 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_02
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_03 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_03
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_04 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_04
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_05 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_05
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_06 }
        clear_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_06
    }
}

gdd_allocate_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_slot = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_01 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_01
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_02 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_02
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_03 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_03
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_04 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_04
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_05 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_05
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_saved_global_event_target = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_06 } }
        save_global_event_target_as = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_06
    }
}

gdd_build_eoc_great_feudatory_roster = {
    gdd_clear_eoc_great_feudatory_roster = yes
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            exists = yes
            has_country_flag = zhx_member
            has_country_flag = zhx_major_feudatory
            NOT = { tag = YAN }
            NOT = { has_country_flag = zhx_tianzi }
        }
        gdd_allocate_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_slot = yes
    }
    set_global_flag = gdd_eoc_great_feudatory_roster_initialised
}
